title: Spanish (European)

personNotes.tú: you, one person you know well

tutor: European Spanish as spoken in Spain (use vosotros where relevant, and Spain vocabulary like "vale")

roadmap.title: Telling a story
roadmap.can: Tell a story with both pasts: estaba en casa cuando sonó el teléfono

roadmap.title: At the doctor's
roadmap.can: Say what hurts and follow advice: me duele la cabeza, tengo fiebre

roadmap.title: Would you mind?
roadmap.can: Be polite and imagine with the condicional: me gustaría, podría, ¿te importaría?

roadmap.title: B1 checkpoint
roadmap.can: Talk about your past, your plans and your opinions in one longer conversation, then check your level
